name: Prado del Rey (Spain)
description: Vertical tricolour of magenta, white and magenta, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Prado del Rey (a crowned monogram on blue above two wheels).
history: Municipal flag of Prado del Rey; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: Prado del Rey arms — crowned monogram above two wheels
